# Filing360 (filingedge360.com)

> Online company registration, GST, income tax (ITR) filing and MCA compliance for founders and businesses in India. CA-backed filings with transparent professional fees.

## Primary services
- Company registration: Private Limited, LLP, OPC, Partnership, Section 8, Trust
- GST: registration, returns, LUT, amendment, cancellation, refunds
- Income tax: ITR filing, tax planning, TDS, notices, tax audit
- MCA compliance: annual filings, director changes, capital changes
- Accounting / CFO, Funds (CMA, TEV, pitch deck), digital services
